gold.note: Market data is more than 40 minutes old (market closed or feed delayed); ranges not issued.

oil.note: Market data is more than 40 minutes old (market closed or feed delayed); ranges not issued.

method_note: Calibrated price ranges, NOT direction forecasts: direction cannot be predicted better than chance (strict walk-forward studies). Each range says where the price is likely to be at the horizon; live_coverage is how often real prices actually landed inside these ranges.
data_note: Based on Yahoo Finance futures 5-minute bars (GC=F, CL=F), which can be delayed several minutes; because the newest price is already several minutes old, each range covers the delay PLUS the horizon (see spans_minutes_of_movement) so that it is honest about 'minutes from now'.
